sources.classes: ESA WorldCover v200 legend: 10 tree cover, 20 shrubland, 30 grassland, 40 cropland, 50 built-up, 60 bare / sparse vegetation, 70 snow and ice, 80 permanent water, 90 herbaceous wetland, 95 mangroves, 100 moss and lichen. Value 0 is the scheme's no-data class and has no entry (it classifies as unknown).
sources.surfaces: The default ground surface of each class is [assumed]: forest floor and fields dirt, shrub and grass land grass, built-up ground asphalt (courtyards and car parks), bare ground compacted, water water. Snow has no SurfaceKind (the enum is append-only) and stays unknown. Roads, sidewalks and junctions override this from their own attributes (design 6.5); the game reads only paved / unpaved road versus the rest today, so this base class is new information it ignores at first.
